query:
-- Absolue de Rose de Mai - Citronellol (composant principal)
INSERT INTO raw_material_molecules (raw_material_id, molecule_id, percentage, is_signature, variability, notes)
SELECT rm.id, m.id, 35.0, 1, 'stable', 'Composant principal de l''absolue de rose'
FROM raw_materials rm, molecules m
WHERE rm.material_id = 'RM-ABS-001' AND m.name LIKE '%Citronellol%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_material_molecules rmm WHERE rmm.raw_material_id = rm.id AND rmm.molecule_id = m.id)
LIMIT 1;
